title: The Big Match
lines: Ben and Meg have a pitching match.
Both of them stand on the bridge.
Ben pitches a stick in the ditch.
Meg catches it and pitches it back.
Mom sits on the edge and checks the match.
Ben pitches it in the mud. Miss!
Meg wins the match and gets the badge.
Then the pals split the fudge on the bridge.

questions.listenFor: Mom, sitting on the edge of the bridge. Stated in the story - have them find that line and read it back.
His last stick went in the mud. If they say "Meg won," ask "and where did Ben's stick land?"

questions.ask: What do you think the pals did with the fudge? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: The story says they split it. Listen for the reason after it - they are pals, or Meg shared even though she won.
